Domaine des Trois Chênes: 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), clay/flint soils, ~62,000 bottles/year; 2024 hail cut output to 48,000. Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, earliest certification 2026. Exports 41% (Belgium, Japan); Japan requires sulphites under 60 mg/L.

Past failures: 2022 tank 4 controller drift cost €11,000 (now calibrated pre-harvest, second probe fitted); 2023 vintage mislabelling recalled 900 bottles (proofs need two signatures).

Rules: no irrigation on western plots; harvest dates from three mornings of sugar/acidity tests; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

Open: lighter bottles (importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison); eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided (54-year-old vines, yields down 30%).
